integrity: An analytic Hilbert-space argument, including a Fourier convolution reduction and a min-max proof, is provided. Numerical checks are supplementary, not substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The isolated eigenvalues are not individually evaluated, their multiplicities and counting growth rates remain open. The theorem uses distinct diameters for compact cross terms; coincidence has different essential spectrum. Full priority screening cannot rule out unindexed special two-diameter studies.
title: Angular collision creates infinitely many isolated Bergman trace eigenvalues
